ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather and Sky its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather and Sky its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather and Sky its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Weather and Sky its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather and Sky its resources.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Sounds that alert us? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Sounds that alert us.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Sounds that alert us.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Sounds that alert us.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Sounds that alert us.

4. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Water.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Soil its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil its resources.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of water? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of water.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of water.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of water.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of water.

8. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

9. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Nitrogen gas only

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Plants its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Plants its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Plants its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Plants its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Plants its resources.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Keeping home? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Keeping home.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Keeping home.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Keeping home.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Keeping home.

12. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Producers
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Primary consumers only

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Soil its resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Plants its resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Animals resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Energy resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
